summary: The reconcile look tests' fixture opens a file-backed store in a tempdir instead of a shared-cache memory store, so the test's read no longer fails at once with SQLITE_LOCKED while a look task writes on the multi-threaded runtime (#4720)

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, wire or harness change; only one_look_fixture, its two callers and a new test in crates/fractal-reconcile/src/reconcile.rs.
